async def work(items):
    WIDTH = 4
    ONE = 1
    for i in range(0, len(items), 1):
      # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
      await asyncio.gather(read(items[i]), other(items[i]))
    for i in range(0, len(items), 2):
      # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
      await asyncio.gather(read(items[i]), other(items[i]))
    for i in range(0, len(items), WIDTH):
      # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
      await asyncio.gather(read(items[i]), other(items[i]))
    for i in range(0, len(items), ONE):
      # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
      await asyncio.gather(read(items[i]), other(items[i]))
    for i in range(0, len(items), unknownWidth):
      # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
